name: EventTicketSelector
tagline: The Event Ticket Selector turns one text column into a complete ticket chooser.
description: The Event Ticket Selector turns one text column into a complete ticket chooser. Visitors see every ticket tier as a card with its price, description and status, choose quantities with large + and - buttons, add optional extras (parking, workshops, transport), type a promo code and watch the order total update straight away - including booking fees and GST.
features: Shows seats left ("Only 6 left"), sold out, sales ended and sale ends soon so visitors are never surprised
Respects per-tier limits (for example max 4 VIP seats), an order limit (for example 10 tickets) and sets (corporate seats in blocks of 5)
Treats add-ons separately: they never count towards the ticket limit, and they need at least one ticket in the same order
Applies promo codes as a percentage or an amount off, optionally only for some tiers
Adds a booking fee per paid ticket and GST (included in prices or added on top)
Filters by category, searches and sorts long ticket lists, and on phones keeps a sticky total bar at the bottom of the screen
